findings.title: Holistic production UX review failed

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does the whole experience feel like a real production community app for the target users, not merely an implemented workflow harness?
holisticQuestionAnswers.why: The review cannot claim production-grade UX while workflow/persona evidence or screenshot visual inspection is incomplete/failing.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Complete workflow/persona coverage and remediate visual/layout scorecard failures before claiming production-grade UX.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Is the UI modern, easy to use, easy to navigate, and visually appealing for the target persona?
holisticQuestionAnswers.why: 195 rows use non-screen visible text sources and 185 rows have visual/layout blockers, so the judge cannot make a reliable modern-UI claim.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Use screenshot-derived visible text and fix detected checklist, repeated-card, thin-content, or weak-identity visual blockers before rerunning the judge.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Is the overall information architecture organized around community content and real jobs-to-be-done instead of workflow lists or validation surfaces?
holisticQuestionAnswers.why: Failing workflow/persona scorecards or visual blockers prevent a holistic community IA pass.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Replace generic workflow-list or validation surfaces with domain-native community sections and rerun scorecards.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does the visible UI avoid blocking or major overlap, clipping, crowding, default-scaffold, repeated-card, checklist-modal, and thin-content defects?
holisticQuestionAnswers.why: The judge cannot clear layout/content defects while row-level evidence remains incomplete, unsupported, or visually failing.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Complete screenshot-backed review rows and remediate any row-level layout/content defects.
